title: T.J. Edwards: Fourth down pass to Jahmyr Gibbs a look we saw all week

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: T.J. Edwards: Fourth down pass to Jahmyr Gibbs a look we saw all week
sources.description: The Bears had a hard time stopping Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs throughout Thursday's game in Detroit, so it made sense that the Lions put the ball in Gibbs's hands on fourth down with just over two minutes left to play.
